answer: Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sparrow of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The vertex of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
